definition: Contract law governs enforceable agreements: offer, acceptance, consideration, capacity, and free consent. The Indian Contract Act, 1872 (Sections 1–75 in this course) sets the general law; the Specific Relief Act, 1963 provides remedies when damages are inadequate.

statutoryReferences.note: Use the bare act edition prescribed by your faculty
